name: Auto Smelter Datapack, Ores Drop Ingots Without a Furnace
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: MD22
description: Auto-smelting as you mine: iron, gold and copper ore give finished ingots straight from the block, no furnace and no fuel. Fortune and Silk Touch work exactly as in vanilla. Server-side datapack.
evidence: Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
